title: ASCII Kinesis V2 Locomotion 025 — Buoyancy Surrender / Bank Catch Runout

source.identity: Zora — The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess HD — Wii U — NPCs
observed: The commissioned evidence treats the full 128×318 static sheet as one source corpus.
The static sheet contains multiple water-adjacent and travel/action pose families useful only as eligibility evidence for a medium-transition locomotion study.
The static sheet supplies no trustworthy source-authentic exposure duration, root trajectory, support transfer chronology, or authored water-to-bank mechanics.
unknown: Source-authentic chronology/exposure, root coordinates, support-transfer timing, buoyancy decay, bank-contact forces, and gameplay cadence are unknown.

rights.output_description: independent generic ASCII biped/root-support rig crossing an abstract waterline/bank boundary

novelty.new_causality: Forward travel begins under buoyancy support. A bank-side foot probes and becomes trustworthy fixed support before buoyancy authority decays; the body rises while inherited horizontal travel survives, producing an overlong first free-ground catch followed by progressively shorter corrections and delayed upper-body recovery.
failure_if: buoyancy disappears before fixed bank support is earned
root stops at the bank instead of preserving travel
water support and fixed-foot support swap by teleport
first free-ground catch is not visibly overlong
root/COM vertical rise reads as an instant pop
secondary torso/leg lag snaps home or ends in the entry pose

timing.playback_policy: authored decisive causal keys with explicit holds; support-medium topology changes are authored keys; no reverse interpolation

rig.support_rule: Buoyancy remains an explicit support medium until K06. Right-foot fixed support must be earned at K03 before water support begins to unload.
rig.medium_rule: K00-K05 retain nonzero buoyancy; K03 establishes RIGHT fixed support; K04-K05 progressively surrender buoyancy; K06 reaches zero buoyancy under trusted RIGHT support.
rig.runout_rule: K07 is the largest root-spacing event after medium surrender; K08-K13 progressively brake/correct/settle with shorter spacing.
rig.secondary_rule: Upper-body lag rises through bank acquisition and peaks after the free-ground overrun, then decays after root braking without resetting to entry.

keys.name: WATER_GLIDE_ENTRY
keys.causal_role: establish forward travel while buoyancy owns vertical support and neither foot may claim fixed ground

keys.name: BANK_COMPRESSION_PREP
keys.causal_role: compress and reach the bank without stopping forward root travel; right foot remains a probe

keys.name: RIGHT_BANK_PROBE
keys.causal_role: right foot touches fixed bank while buoyancy still owns most vertical load; probe is not trusted support

keys.name: RIGHT_BANK_CATCH_EARNED
keys.causal_role: earn the first fixed-ground catch before reducing buoyancy authority

keys.name: BUOYANCY_SURRENDER_A
keys.causal_role: transfer vertical support toward the fixed right foot while root rises and keeps moving forward

keys.name: BUOYANCY_SURRENDER_B
keys.causal_role: continue the rise and reduce buoyancy without clamping horizontal velocity; left leg swings free

keys.name: FIXED_GROUND_OWNS_BODY
keys.causal_role: water support reaches zero only after fixed-ground ownership is trustworthy; forward runout survives

keys.name: LEFT_FREE_CATCH_OVERRUN
keys.causal_role: surviving forward velocity produces the deliberately overlong first free-ground catch after buoyancy release

keys.name: LEFT_BRAKE_COMPRESSION
keys.causal_role: hold the overlong catch and compress root/COM to brake translation while upper-body lag still advances

keys.name: RIGHT_CORRECTION_PROBE
keys.causal_role: right foot probes under the braking body while left support remains trusted; correction ownership is not allowed to teleport

keys.name: RIGHT_SHORT_CORRECTION_CATCH
keys.causal_role: right support becomes trustworthy only after the authored probe and catches the residual translation with a shorter spacing event

keys.name: LEFT_FINAL_PROBE
keys.causal_role: left foot probes a final shorter correction while right remains trusted, preserving explicit support topology

keys.name: LEFT_FINAL_CORRECTION_CATCH
keys.causal_role: final trusted correction is smaller again and arrests root debt without recreating the water-entry stance

keys.name: TORSO_LAG_PAYDOWN
keys.causal_role: root slows first while torso and trailing leg continue to settle, paying secondary lag after the support corrections

keys.name: DISPLACED_RECOVERY_DEBT
keys.causal_role: finish displaced with live next-step debt rather than restoring the original buoyant entry pose

motion_dungeon.compile_chain: AUTHORED ASCII KEYS + SUPPORT-MEDIUM PROFILE -> DETERMINISTIC KEY HOLDS -> ASCII-ONLY FRAME RENDER -> H.264 MP4 -> SPA

required_visible: earned bank probe→catch before buoyancy surrender
progressive root/COM rise while travel survives

rounds.highest_value_visible_defect: Post-overrun correction changed directly from left support to trusted right support; the support transfer read as a teleport rather than an earned counterstep.
rounds.correction: Insert an authored right-foot fixed-ground probe while left remains trusted, then a separate shorter right catch; keep subsequent left correction probe/catch shorter again.

rounds.reason: Bank-side fixed contact is visibly probed then earned before buoyancy falls; root/COM rise while forward travel survives; K07 is an overlong free-ground catch; both later support changes are probe→catch events with shorter spacing; torso/leg lag settles after root braking and the body remains displaced.

noodle_queen.reason: The bank is a mechanical boundary rather than scenery: buoyancy visibly yields only after a planted foot earns ownership, the overrun has teeth, and the corrections shrink without collapsing into a walk cycle.
